The Executive Board of the European Central Bank may exercise powers delegated to it by the Governing Council of the European Central Bank. The Executive Board of the European Central Bank is composed of the President of the Bank, the Vice-President, and four other members. The Executive Board of the European Central Bank is responsible for the day-to-day running of the European Central Bank. Members of the Executive Board of the European Central Bank are appointed from among persons of recognised standing and professional experience in monetary or banking matters.
